summary: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose the First Amendment to its existing Equity Distribution Agreement, extending the maximum maturity of forward sale agreements from 18 to 24 months. No new shares were authorized; the $900 million aggregate cap and commission structure remain unchanged. Approximately $630 million in shares have already been sold, leaving $270 million available for future at-the-market offerings. The amendment is a routine update to an existing sales program, not a special situation event such as a tender, spin-off, or restructuring. The filing includes no extraordinary corporate action, board recommendation, or regulatory timeline.
